welcome: Welcome to Underfoot! Right-drag to pan, use the mouse wheel to zoom, and press Space to pause any time.
dig: Pick the Dig tool and drag with the left mouse button to mark soil. Workers will tunnel there for you.
chamber: Open tunnels can become chambers. Use the Chamber tool with LMB to assign a type like nursery or food store.
queen: The Queen lays eggs in the queen chamber. Keep her fed and safe and she'll keep the colony growing.
brood: Eggs become larvae, then pupae, then ants. Nurses carry brood to the nursery and feed it.
surface: Press Tab to switch between the nest and the surface. The yard is big, bright and full of things that eat ants.
trail: Draw scent trails on the surface with the Trail tool (LMB). Foragers follow your scent to food and back.
erase: Made a mess? The Erase tool wipes scent so ants stop marching somewhere silly.
food_found: A scout found food! Draw a trail to it and workers will haul it home. Big items need several ants.
castes: Press C to open the caste panel and choose how many larvae become workers, soldiers, scouts or nurses.
starving: The colony is starving! Find sugar or protein fast, or the Queen will stop laying and ants will die.
air: Stale air slows ants down in deep chambers. Press 1 for the air overlay and dig shafts to the surface.
flood: Rain seeps into low tunnels. Press 2 for the water overlay and dig a sump chamber below your nest.
mould: Mould spreads from damp, dirty chambers. Press 4 for the mould overlay and keep the midden far from the food.
spider: A wolf spider is hunting nearby! Send soldiers in numbers. Alone, an ant is just a snack.
rain: Rain is coming. Foragers will head home, and scent trails wash away. Watch the water overlay.
mower: LAWNMOWER! Everything on the surface in its path is in danger. Pull your foragers home now.
rival: Red ants live under the gnome. Their trails smell different, and their soldiers bite. Raid them, or guard your food.
winter: Winter is here. Ants slow down and food is scarce. Dig deep, stock up and wait for spring.
flight: At the end of spring, winged royals can go on a nuptial flight. Success earns trait points and new nests.
traits: You have trait points! Press E to open the evolution tree and choose how your colony evolves.
satellite: A new queen has founded a satellite nest. Link it to home with surface trails to share food.
house: You've reached the House. Food is everywhere, but so is the cat. Stay along the skirting boards.
escalation: The homeowner has noticed you. Too many ants in sight raise the alert level, so keep trails short and quiet.
exterminator: The exterminator is here! Pull ants away from the poison and wait for the van to leave, or make a stand.
beetle_mount: A rhinoceros beetle! Lead enough soldiers to it and they can ride it into battle.
collapse: A tunnel collapsed! Wide spans without support cave in. Keep chambers small or evolve better architecture.
overlay: Nest overlays: 1 air, 2 water, 3 heat, 4 mould. Press P on the surface to see scent trails.
inspect: Click an ant, chamber or creature to inspect it. Press F to follow the selected ant, and G to open the field guide.
speed: Press ] to speed time up and [ to slow it down. Space pauses. Esc opens the menu.
